item.title: Assassin's Creed Shadows Title Update 1.1.7 Out This Week On Switch 2, Here Are The Patch Notes
item.description: Switch 2 version resolves crashes and stability issues.Assassin's Creed Shadows didn't get off to the best start on the Switch 2 when it arrived earlier this month, with players reporting crashing and stability issues.Fortunately, Ubisoft acknowledged these problems and said these issues would be resolved in the next major game update. Title Update 1.1.7 is out this week on the Switch 2 and other platforms, and we've now got a look at the patch notes.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong Expansion Coming 2026, Hollow Knight: Switch 2 Edition Also Announced
item.description: Free update and free upgrade confirmed.Before the talented developer Team Cherry signs off for 2025, it's got some exciting news to share. The "first big" Hollow Knight: Silksong expansion is already in the works and is scheduled to arrive in 2026.This new content, officially titled Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow, will come packed with new areas, bosses, tools and much more. Perhaps, best of all, it's free to all players when it arrives next year.Read the full article on nintendolife.co

item.title: Nintendo Music Update Adds Super Mario's OG Game Boy Outing, Here's Every Song Included
